verdict.rationale: Yubico's mobile SDKs document NFC support. YubiKit Android supports NFC-enabled YubiKeys and offers a FIDO2/WebAuthn client with WebView integration. YubiKit iOS supports NFC YubiKeys on iOS devices, but only for requesting OTPs. So NFC tap-to-authenticate is evidenced mainly as something app developers build in, not as an out-of-the-box experience. Missing for 10: evidence of NFC authentication in mobile browsers (Safari/Chrome), FIDO2/passkey over NFC on iOS, and any independent or hands-on confirmation of the mobile NFC experience.
